title: Java, Al Hirt's hit and first BMI royalties
summary: Java did nothing until Al Hirt covered it; Tyler got no royalties until a BMI office found him while on tour with Little Richard.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
